notes: Single source of truth for deploy paths. The top-level values are the DEFAULT target (GitHub Pages). CI selects a target with `python3 scripts/set-deploy-target.py <name>`, which copies that entry over the top-level values before the build. Prefer importing via lib/site.ts (TS) or scripts/_site_config.py (Python).

ghpages.notes: Project page at deltavgit.github.io/website-private — needs the basePath prefix, so the build runs scripts/patch-basepath.py.

cloudflare.notes: Cloudflare Pages project `websitegit`, serving the apex deltav.cc and www.deltav.cc. Root domain, so basePath is empty and patch-basepath.py is a no-op.
